title: parthenium hispidum var. auriculatum
intro: Parthenium hispidum var. auriculatum, commonly known as Parthenium auriculatum, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Parthenium auriculatum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing fever, treating skin disorders, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable medicinal plant.
